_doc: ROUND 12 (prison only): noise, hordes and special infected (scripts/prison/prison_noise.gd, prison_special.gd). Read once at start-up. kinds: what each noise is: loud (tiles, used when a caller gives 0), heat (what one costs the region's heat), cap (the most dead one noise may call), wake (the chance at no distance for a dormant one), see (0 to 1: the share of awake dead that turn to it), ripple (a ring on the ground when it is Ruth's own), to (where they go: spot = the noise, fence = the nearest fence segment). Probability of a dead one hearing at `h` tiles of a noise of radius `r` is wake * (1 - h/r)^fall. h is the distance plus `wall` tiles for every wall tile between (at most `wall_max`). heat: the noise heat of a 16-tile region rises by kind and falls `decay` a second; quiet under `loud_at`, loud under `very_at`, very loud above; the cap of one noise grows by `cap_per_heat` for each point of heat. interest: how long a dead one that went to look mills about at the spot before it loses interest. horde: when more dead than `join_n` are called at once the nearest others within `join_r` tiles follow, up to `join_max`. raid_horde / base_horde: the migrating and the siege hordes. specials: the special infected (stats by kind, the nights they begin, how many a night, the raids' chances).

raid_heat._doc: RAID HEAT (docs/raid-heat-spec.md): one 0 to 100 value for a raid, filled by the same Noise.emit calls (add: points per kind; a shot scales with the square of the gun's radius over 12 tiles, once per 0.2 s) and by a slow trickle (trickle_per_min). Stages begin at `stages` (Stirring, Hunted, Overrun). Heat cools `cool_per_s` after `cool_after_s` of nothing loud, never below the start of the stage already reached. quiet_r: in Quiet a noise wakes a sleeper only this near. hunted: the one horde from a map edge (size, speed). overrun: a wave from an edge every `every_s` seconds (size) until the party leaves, the first after `first_s`. loot: companions' auto-loot (prison_squad.gd) is read from prison_weapons.json `squad`.

toasts.screamer: A screamer! Kill it before it calls the horde.
toasts.bloater: A bloater. Shoot it from far away: it bursts into poison gas.
toasts.hunter: A hunter! It leaps. Press F to shove it off when it pins you.
toasts.breacher: A breacher. It rams the fence: kill it before the wall goes.
toasts.patient: The patient was not asleep. It lunges!
toasts.horde_raid: A horde is crossing the town. Keep away from it, or lure it off with a thrown bottle (G).
toasts.horde_base: A horde is coming at the fence.
